articles.title: Meloni, Italia più solida e credibile, anche l'occupazione lo testimonia
articles.summary: Premier Meloni states that Italy's main macroeconomic indicators show a more solid and credible nation, with record employment rates and historic lows in unemployment.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Un presidente della Repubblica di destra potrebbe non essere più un tabù'
articles.summary: Meloni states that a right-wing president of the Republic could cease to be a taboo if her coalition wins the next elections.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Premier Meloni is available to testify as a civil party witness in Milan on September 28 in a defamation trial against Fabrizio Corona.
